verses.arabicText: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.transliteration: Sad wal-qur'āni dhī dh-dhik'r
verses.translation: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders

verses.arabicText: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verses.transliteration: Bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatiw-washiqāq
verses.translation: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition

verses.arabicText: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.transliteration: Kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣ
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape

verses.arabicText: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirum-min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhāb
verses.translation: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar

verses.arabicText: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.transliteration: Ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhaw-wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujāb
verses.translation: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”

verses.arabicText: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayoy-yurād
verses.translation: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺

verses.arabicText: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
verses.transliteration: Mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāq
verses.translation: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication

verses.arabicText: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.transliteration: A-unzila ʿalayhi dh-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkim-min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb
verses.translation: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.transliteration: Am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahāb
verses.translation: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum mul'ku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbāb
verses.translation: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺

verses.arabicText: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.transliteration: Jundum-mā hunālika mahzūmum-mina l-aḥzāb
verses.translation: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw-waʿāduw-wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtād
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures

verses.arabicText: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.transliteration: Wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭiw-wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzāb
verses.translation: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces

verses.arabicText: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.transliteration: In kullun illā kadhaba r-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb
verses.translation: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatam-mā lahā min fawāq
verses.translation: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabicText: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwāb
verses.translation: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāq
verses.translation: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise

verses.arabicText: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullul-lahu awwāb
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺

verses.arabicText: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭāb
verses.translation: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.transliteration: Wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāb
verses.translation: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.transliteration: Idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi ṣ-ṣirāṭ
verses.translation: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿuw-watis'ʿūna naʿjataw-waliya naʿjatuw-wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭāb
verses.translation: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.transliteration: Qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīram-mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlum-mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿaw-wa-anāb
verses.translation: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺

verses.arabicText: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.transliteration: Faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maāb
verses.translation: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

verses.arabicText: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna n-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqnā s-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū mina n-nār
verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire

verses.arabicText: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujār
verses.translation: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked

verses.arabicText: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakul-liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwāb
verses.translation: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.transliteration: Idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi ṣ-ṣāfinātu l-jiyād
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening

verses.arabicText: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.transliteration: Faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb
verses.translation: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight

verses.arabicText: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāq
verses.translation: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāb
verses.translation: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kal-lā yanbaghī li-aḥadim-min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahāb
verses.translation: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”

verses.arabicText: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.transliteration: Fasakharnā lahu r-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāb
verses.translation: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased

verses.arabicText: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verses.transliteration: Wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāiw-waghawwāṣ
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn

verses.arabicText: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.transliteration: Waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verses.translation: and others bound together in chains

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisāb
verses.translation: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maāb
verses.translation: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya sh-shayṭānu binuṣ'biw-waʿadhāb
verses.translation: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”

verses.arabicText: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: Ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāriduw-washarāb
verses.translation: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatam-minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verses.translation: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason

verses.arabicText: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran-niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwāb
verses.translation: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣār
verses.translation: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā d-dār
verses.translation: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyār
verses.translation: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullum-mina l-akhyār
verses.translation: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā dhik'ruw-wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maāb
verses.translation: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination

verses.arabicText: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.transliteration: Jannāti ʿadnim-mufattaḥatal-lahumu l-abwāb
verses.translation: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratiw-washarāb
verses.translation: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: Waʿindahum qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarfi atrāb
verses.translation: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min-nafād
verses.translation: This is indeed Our provision that will never end

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maāb
verses.translation: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination

verses.arabicText: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.transliteration: Jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihād
verses.translation: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmuw-waghassāq
verses.translation: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus

verses.arabicText: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.transliteration: Waākharu min shaklihi azwāj
verses.translation: and other torments of the same sort

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā fawjum-muq'taḥimum-maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū n-nār
verses.translation: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarār
verses.translation: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī n-nār
verses.translation: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrār
verses.translation: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly

verses.arabicText: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣār
verses.translation: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli n-nār
verses.translation: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā anā mundhiruw-wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme

verses.arabicText: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news

verses.arabicText: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”

verses.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn
verses.translation: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺

verses.arabicText: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Iy-yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharam-min ṭīn
verses.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi mir-rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verses.translation: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

verses.arabicText: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verses.translation: So the angels prostrated all together—

verses.arabicText: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīn
verses.translation: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīn
verses.translation: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Qāla anā khayrum-min'hu khalaqtanī min-nāriw-wakhalaqtahu min ṭīn
verses.translation: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīm
verses.translation: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi d-dīn
verses.translation: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.translation: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verses.translation: Allah said, “You will be delayed

verses.arabicText: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.transliteration: Ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verses.translation: until the appointed Day.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.translation: except Your chosen servants among them.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūl
verses.translation: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—

verses.arabicText: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: La-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajriw-wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illā dhik'rul-lil'ʿālamīn
verses.translation: It is only a reminder to the whole world

verses.arabicText: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīn
verses.translation: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”
